context: Two teens trade strange happenings at school
purpose: Teach: なくっ/さっさと/あたかも/ともあれ/おかしな/らしき/あまりの/有難う

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、聞いてよ。昨日おかしな話を聞いたんだけど、信じられる?
lines.en: Hey, listen. I heard a strange story yesterday — can you believe it?
lines.style: Excited teen girl leaning in close, eyes wide with juicy gossip energy

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: またその手の話?あたかも本当にあったみたいに話すよね、桜って。
lines.en: That kind of story again? You always talk as if it actually happened, Sakura.
lines.style: Skeptical teen boy half-amused half-annoyed, dragging out words with mock exhaustion

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本当だってば!あまりの怖さに声も出なくって、その場で固まっちゃったんだから。
lines.en: It's true! I was so scared I couldn't even speak — I just froze on the spot.
lines.style: Voice rising in pitch, gesturing wildly, totally convinced and a little breathless

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: へえ、ホラー映画じゃあるまいし。誰かのいたずらだって思わないの?
lines.en: Wow, it's not a horror movie. Don't you think it might just be someone's prank?
lines.style: Dry sarcastic teen tone, arms crossed, raising one eyebrow in clear doubt

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私もそう思ったよ。でも先生らしき人影が消えた直後に、三人もケガしたらしいの。
lines.en: I thought so too. But right after a teacher-like figure vanished, three people supposedly got hurt.
lines.style: Defensive teen voice, slightly hurt he's not taking her seriously, speaking faster

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: まじかよ。ともあれ、部活はさっさと切り上げて見に行こうぜ。
lines.en: Seriously? Anyway, let's wrap up club early and go check it out.
lines.style: Suddenly hooked, lowering voice conspiratorially, grinning with curious excitement

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: やった!誘ってくれて有難う。でも昼間ね、夜は絶対やだから!
lines.en: Yes! Thanks for inviting me along. But daytime only — I absolutely refuse to go at night!
lines.style: Bright relieved laugh, clapping hands once, then quickly turning serious about the night rule
